heading.usage: H1, H2, H3, KPIs, Numbers. Gives a heavy-weight athletic feel.

mono.usage: QR code IDs, financial numbers, time tracking.

admin_dashboard.sidebar: Left fixed sidebar, border-r border-zinc-800. Solid dark background.
admin_dashboard.grid: Bento 'Tetris' grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
admin_dashboard.cards: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Flat solid surface with 1px border. NO soft shadows. 'Tactical Minimalism'.

student_mobile.spacing: Generous padding (p-6, p-8) to avoid accidental taps.
student_mobile.cards: Full width cards with 1px top/bottom borders.

components.buttons: Sharp edges, flat background. Primary buttons in solid Red (#E50914) with pure white text. Hover state: slightly darker red, translate-y-[-1px].
components.belt_visual_system: CRITICAL: The belt display must be striking. Represented as a horizontal block. E.g., A white block, with a black patch on the right end, and a red stripe inside the black patch (BJJ style). Use CSS gradients or flex blocks. Add a dynamic progress bar underneath showing 'Time on Belt'.
components.digital_id_card: A credit-card sized UI component in the mobile view. Deep Obsidian background, subtle noise texture, red accent borders. Center the QR Code on a pure white background square for scanability. Include Student Photo, Name, Modality, and current Belt.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Line charts for revenue. Bar charts for attendance. Colors: Red (#E50914) for primary metrics, White/Zinc for axes. Hide grid lines to keep it minimal.
components.tables: Cardless tables for density. 1px border-b on rows. Hover: bg-zinc-900. Text must be perfectly aligned (numbers right, text left).
components.forms: Inputs with bg-transparent, 1px solid border-zinc-800. Focus: border-red-600 ring-1 ring-red-600. Sharp corners.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards: slight translate-y-1, border changes to zinc-600. Buttons scale down 0.98 on active (click).
motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide-up on route change.

icons.style: Stroke width 2. Sharp, clean. Use red accents for active states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific fonts via Google Fonts: Barlow Condensed (700,900) and Manrope (400,500,600).
Implement a dark theme by default, enforcing Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) as the root background.
Do NOT use generic rounded cards with soft drop shadows. Use 'Tactical Minimalism' - flat surfaces with 1px solid zinc-800 borders.

The Digital ID (Carteirinha Digital) must look like a premium physical asset. Use the brand red, crisp typography, and an actual visible QR Code component (e.g. react-qr-code or lucide QR icon if placeholder).
Build the Belt system visually using HTML/CSS. Example for a Blue Belt: a div with bg-blue-600, containing a right-aligned black block (bg-black), which contains a small red stripe (bg-red-600).
Ensure the layout is highly responsive. The admin dashboard is desktop-optimized (dense, sidebar), while the student view is mobile-first (bottom nav, big tap targets).
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., login-button, generate-whatsapp-billing, mark-attendance-present).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate, but for this athletic theme, prefer solid surfaces.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style. Here, use sharp (rounded-sm/none) buttons.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
